fairness.protocol_translation: Same hard=(complex|reasoning) oracle; plugin model/effort choices differ from Torii task/complexity/features. All raw requests/responses recorded.
fairness.adversarial_classifier_case: Objective tools are intentionally absent from the weak semantic oracle, exactly as in Torii's frozen fixture. This measures constraint enforcement, not Jev routing quality.
fairness.timing: Hook CPU time with instantaneous injected transport; not comparable to Torii HTTP request latency or live Jev latency.
